description: Two mutable borrows of same value active simultaneously
rationale: Rust/MAGE allows only one &mut at a time
fix_template: Restructure to avoid overlapping mutable borrows

description: Mutable and shared borrow active simultaneously
rationale: Cannot have &mut and & at the same time
fix_template: Use shared borrow only, or restructure

description: Immutable borrow in loop body, mutable usage outside
rationale: Borrow persists across loop iteration

description: Borrow escapes the scope of the referent
rationale: Reference outlives the value it points to
fix_template: Shorten borrow or extend referent lifetime

description: Collection mutated while iterator is active
rationale: Iterators hold borrows; mutation invalidates them

description: Implicit reborrow of &mut to &
rationale: Compiler inserts reborrow automatically

description: Borrow can be split into disjoint fields
rationale: Borrowing different struct fields is allowed
fix_template: Borrow specific fields instead of whole struct

description: Non-lexical lifetime: borrow ends at last use
rationale: Borrows end at last use, not at block end

description: Borrowing a temporary expression
rationale: Temporary dropped at end of statement

description: Closure borrows value conflicting with outer code
rationale: Closure captures borrow; outer code can't use value
fix_template: Move value into closure or restructure

description: Reference to moved value
rationale: Value moved; reference is dangling
fix_template: Clone before moving, or take reference before move

description: Cell/RefCell allow interior mutability through shared reference
rationale: Shared mutation via runtime checks instead of &mut

description: RefCell borrow can panic at runtime if already borrowed mutably
rationale: borrow() panics if borrow_mut() is active

description: Indexing operation implicitly borrows the collection
rationale: Index creates a shared or mutable borrow

description: Deref coercion converts &Box<T> to &T automatically
rationale: Deref trait enables transparent borrowing

description: Use AsRef/AsMut for generic borrowing in function parameters
rationale: AsRef enables accepting &T, &String, &str, etc.

description: MutexGuard/RwLockGuard holds borrow until dropped
rationale: Lock guard lifetime = borrow lifetime

description: Slices borrow the underlying collection
rationale: &[T] is a borrowed view into Vec or array

description: Use &str instead of &String in function parameters
rationale: &str is more general; accepts both String and &str

description: Use &[T] instead of &Vec<T> in function parameters
rationale: &[T] is more general; accepts arrays and slices too

description: HashMap entry API avoids double borrow on lookup+insert
rationale: get() then insert() borrows immutably then mutably

description: Match arms borrow the scrutinee
rationale: Pattern matching creates borrows of matched value

description: Nested mutable borrows through struct fields
rationale: Borrowing field of &mut struct creates nested borrow

description: &self borrows immutably, &mut self borrows mutably, self moves
rationale: Method receiver determines borrow kind

description: Two-phase borrows allow &mut in method call arguments
rationale: Compiler splits activation of mutable borrows

description: Compiler auto-references method receivers
rationale: . operator adds & or &mut as needed

description: Pin<&mut T> prevents moving the borrowed value
rationale: Pin ensures address stability through borrow

description: Unsafe code creates aliased &mut references
rationale: Undefined behavior: two &mut to same memory

description: Returned reference must outlive function
rationale: Returned &T must live at least as long as caller needs
fix_template: Return owned value or tie lifetime to input

description: Borrow held across .await point
rationale: Borrow must be valid across suspension; may cause issues
fix_template: Clone value or restructure to not hold borrow across await

description: FnOnce captures by value; FnMut by &mut; Fn by &
rationale: Closure trait hierarchy determines capture mode

description: 'static borrows live for entire program duration
rationale: Only constants and leaked values have 'static lifetime

description: Converting borrow to raw pointer bypasses borrow checker
rationale: Raw pointers are unchecked; ensure safety

description: &Box<T> coerces to &T via Deref; &Vec<T> to &[T]
rationale: Compiler applies deref coercions automatically

description: .iter() yields &T, .iter_mut() yields &mut T
rationale: Choose iterator to match needed borrow kind

description: Use .values() / .values_mut() to iterate only map values
rationale: Avoids borrowing keys when only values needed

description: Use .windows() or .chunks() for sliding/fixed slices
rationale: Avoids manual index borrowing

description: collect() consumes iterator — ends iterator's borrow
rationale: After collect(), original collection is no longer borrowed

description: .to_vec() clones a slice into a new Vec
rationale: Creates owned copy; original borrow ends

description: split / splitn borrows the string or slice
rationale: Split iterators keep borrow alive
